tolerance_energy.help: if energy difference for this region is below this value it is considered converged

tolerance_dipole.help: convergence for interior iterations to converge polarisation response, solving linear syste,

max_iter.help: Maximum number of iterations for interior iteration

cr_width.help: Charge-response segments (files with the prefix chargeresponse in the map file): width s of their Gaussian induced charges and dipoles, density ~ exp(-r^2/s^2), for the couplings between molecules and with the QM region. Not used by Thole segments

cr_dipole_damping.help: Charge-response segments: dipole-dipole coupling between molecules when one site is a charge-response site; gaussian: Gaussian dipoles of width cr_width; thole: Thole damping with exp_damp
